breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly omits the erroneous instruction that treated K as affecting only the mode shape (and the associated incorrect formula π^2 E I / L^2). Instead, it directly states the correct formula P_cr = π^2 E I / (K L)^2, which properly incorporates K into the effective length, matching the ground truth prompt.
